license_required.quote: No person shall practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting without first applying for and obtaining a license from the Board of Dentistry.

type.quote: the Board of Dentistry shall have the power to formulate, adopt, and promulgate rules as may be necessary to regulate the practice of dentistry in this state

age_minimum.quote: Is twenty-one (21) years of age, or over, at the time of making application to practice dentistry

degree_required.value: Graduate of an accredited dental college
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of an accredited dental college, if the applicant is to practice dentistry

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: "Accredited dental college" means an institution whose dental educational program is accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

exams.name: National Board Dental Examination
exams.quote: Has passed all portions of the National Board Dental Examination

exams.name: Clinical examination approved by the Board
exams.notes: Must have passed within the previous five years
exams.quote: Has passed a written theoretical examination and a clinical examination approved by the Board within the previous five (5) years

exams.name: Jurisprudence examination
exams.notes: Written examination over rules and laws affecting dentistry in Oklahoma
exams.quote: Has passed a written jurisprudence examination over the rules and laws affecting dentistry in this state

interval_years.quote: Upon receipt of the annual renewal fee, the Board shall issue a renewal certificate authorizing the dentist, dental hygienist, or dental assistant to continue the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene, respectively, in this state for a period of one (1) year.

required.quote: Dentists shall complete forty (40) hours of continuing education with no more than twenty (20) hours to be completed online.

hours_per_period.quote: Dentists shall complete forty (40) hours of continuing education

period_years.quote: Continuing education requirements shall be due at the end of each two-year period.

value: live, in-person cardiopulmonary resuscitation class approved by the Board
ethics class approved by the Board
two (2) hours of opioid and scheduled drug prescribing classes
topical_requirements.quote: a live, in-person cardiopulmonary resuscitation class approved by the Board, an ethics class approved by the Board, for a dentist, two (2) hours of opioid and scheduled drug prescribing classes

available.quote: A dentist holding a general dentist license in good standing and having practiced for at least five hundred (500) hours within the previous five (5) years immediately prior to application and having passed a regional examination substantially equivalent to the requirements for this state may apply for licensure by credentials

requirements.value: Dentist must hold a general dentist license in good standing, have practiced at least 500 hours within the previous 5 years, have passed a substantially equivalent regional examination, provide a letter of good standing from all states ever licensed, and pass the jurisprudence examination.
requirements.quote: A dentist holding a general dentist license in good standing and having practiced for at least five hundred (500) hours within the previous five (5) years immediately prior to application and having passed a regional examination substantially equivalent to the requirements for this state may apply for licensure by credentials

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or dental assisting without first applying for and obtaining a license from the Board of Dentistry.

credential_type.quote: the Board shall notify the applicant to appear for the jurisprudence examination at the time and place to be fixed by the Board

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, except a licensed dentist, to practice or attempt to practice dentistry

title_protection.quote: employ or use the words "Doctor" or "Dentist", or the letters "D.D.S." or "D.M.D.", or any modification or derivative thereof, when such use is intended to give the impression that the person is a dentist

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, except a licensed dentist, to practice or attempt to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pleading guilty, nolo contendere, or being convicted of a felony, misdemeanor involving moral turpitude, sex offense, violent crime, Medicaid fraud, insurance fraud, identity theft, embezzlement, or controlled substances violation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pleading guilty or nolo contendere to, or being convicted of, a felony, a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude, any crime in which an individual would be required to be a registered sex offender under state law, any violent crime, Medicaid fraud, insurance fraud, identity theft, embezzlement or a violation of federal or state controlled dangerous substances laws

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting a false diploma, license, certificate, or other false information on an application or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presenting to the Board a false diploma, license, or certificate, or one obtained by fraud or illegal means, or providing other false information on an application or renewal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Persistent inebriety or drug addiction rendering the dentist incompetent, or failing to notify the Board of an impaired licensee within 72 hours
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being, by reason of persistent inebriety or addiction to drugs, incompetent to continue the practice of dentistry or failing to notify the Board of a licensee, permit holder, or other health professional that is practicing while impaired

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing a false, fraudulent, or misleading advertisement or statement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing a false, fraudulent, or misleading advertisement or statement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Authorizing or aiding an unlicensed person to practice dentistry, dental hygiene, or perform a function requiring a Board permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Authorizing or aiding an unlicensed person to practice dentistry, to practice dental hygiene or to perform a function for which a permit from the Board is required

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay fees as required by the State Dental Act or Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to pay fees as required by the State Dental Act or the rules of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to complete continuing education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to complete continuing education requirements

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing oneself to the public as a specialist without holding a dental specialty license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing himself or herself to the public as a specialist in a dental specialty without holding a dental specialty license as listed in Section 328.22 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing below the basic standard of care that an ordinary prudent dentist with similar training and experience would have provided
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing below the basic standard of care of a patient which an ordinary prudent dentist with similar training and experience within the local area would have provided

disciplinary_grounds.description: Endangering patient health by having a highly communicable disease and continuing to practice without appropriate safeguards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Endangering the health of patients by reason of having a highly communicable disease and continuing to practice dentistry without taking appropriate safeguards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry in an unsafe or unsanitary manner or place, including repeated failures to follow CDC or OSHA guidelines
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing dentistry in an unsafe or unsanitary manner or place including but not limited to repeated failures to follow Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) or Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) guidelines

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being shown to be mentally unsound
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being shown to be mentally unsound

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being shown to be grossly immoral where such condition represents a threat to patient care or treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being shown to be grossly immoral and that such condition represents a threat to patient care or treatment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being incompetent to practice dentistry while delivering care to a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being incompetent to practice dentistry while delivering care to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing gross negligence in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing gross negligence in the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing repeated acts of negligence in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing repeated acts of negligence in the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering or effecting a division of fees or agreeing to split fees in exchange for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering to effect or effecting a division of fees, or agreeing to split or divide a fee for dental services with any person, in exchange for the person bringing or referring a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being involuntarily committed to an institution for treatment for substance abuse, until recovery or remission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being involuntarily committed to an institution for treatment for substance abuse, until recovery or remission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using dental laboratory services without issuing a laboratory prescription
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using or attempting to use the services of a dental laboratory or dental laboratory technician without issuing a laboratory prescription

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in nonconsensual physical contact with a patient that is sexual in nature, or verbal communication intended to be sexually demeaning to a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in nonconsensual physical contact with a patient which is sexual in nature, or engaging in a verbal communication which is intended to be sexually demeaning to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry without displaying the license and current renewal certificate at the primary place of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing dentistry without displaying, at the dentist's primary place of practice, the license issued to the dentist by the Board to practice dentistry and the current renewal certificate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being dishonest in a material way with a patient or during the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being dishonest in a material way with a patient or during the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to retain all patient records for at least seven years from the date of last treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to retain all patient records for at least seven (7) years from the date of the last treatment as provided by Section 328.31b of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing a non-dentist corporation or entity to direct, control, or interfere with the dentist's clinical judgment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Allowing any corporation, organization, group, person, or other legal entity, except another dentist or a professional entity that is in compliance with the registration requirements of subsection B of Section 328.31 of this title, to direct, control, or interfere with the dentist's clinical judgment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating another state's dental act resulting in a guilty plea, conviction, or license suspension/revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the state dental act of another state resulting in a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, conviction or suspension or revocation or other sanction by another state board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Writing a false, unnecessary, or excessive prescription for a controlled dangerous substance, or prescribing opioids in excess of statutory limits
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Writing a false, unnecessary, or excessive prescription for any drug or narcotic which is a controlled dangerous substance under either federal or state law, or prescribing, dispensing or administering opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or administering any drug or treatment without having established a valid dentist-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or administering any drug or treatment without having established a valid dentist-patient relationship

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to cooperate during an investigation or providing false information to the Board or its agents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to cooperate during an investigation or providing false information, verbally or in writing, to the Board, the Board's investigator or an agent of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to complete an approved two-hour course on opioid and scheduled drug prescribing within one year of obtaining a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to complete an approved two-hour course on opioid and scheduled drug prescribing within one (1) year of obtaining a license

definition_quote.value: The following acts by any person shall be regarded as practicing dentistry within the meaning of the State Dental Act: Representing oneself to the public as being a dentist or as one authorized to practice dentistry; Representing oneself to the public as being able to diagnose or examine clinical material or contract for the treating thereof; Removing human teeth; Repairing or filling cavities in human teeth; Correcting or attempting to correct malposed teeth; Administering anesthetics, general or local; Treating deformities of the jaws and adjacent structures; Using x-ray and interpreting dental x-ray film; Operating or prescribing for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or any physical condition connected with the human mouth; Taking impressions of the teeth and jaws; Furnishing, supplying, constructing, reproducing, or repairing prosthetic dentures; Adjusting or attempting to adjust any prosthetic denture, bridge, appliance, or any other structure to be worn in the human mouth; Writing a laboratory prescription to a dental laboratory; Owning, maintaining, or operating an office or offices for the practice of dentistry
definition_quote.quote: The following acts by any person shall be regarded as practicing dentistry within the meaning of the State Dental Act

Conscious Sedation Permit (Parenteral Sedation)

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: All licensees engaged in the practice of dentistry in this state shall notify the Board within twenty-four (24) hours of the discovery of a death of a patient, or an emergency hospital visit where the patient is admitted, pursuant to treatment in a dental office and potentially related to the practice of dentistry by the licensee.

specialist_license_available.quote: The Board of Dentistry may issue a dental specialty license authorizing a dentist to represent himself or herself to the public as a specialist, and to practice as a specialist, in a dental specialty.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: Any person holding an Oklahoma specialty license that does not have an Oklahoma general dentistry license shall be limited to practicing that specialty for which they hold a license.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Supervision" means direct supervision, direct visual supervision, indirect supervision or general supervision

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A dentist may employ not more than the equivalent of three full-time dental hygienists for each dentist actively practicing in the same dental office.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist with a minimum of two (2) years of licensed active hygiene practice may apply to the Board for an advanced procedure permit for elder care and public health.

Residential care home

advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A licensed dentist may allow a dental hygienist with an elder care advanced procedure permit to treat patients under general supervision by utilizing teledentistry on a patient in: A nursing facility, specialized facility, or nursing care component of a continuum of care facility ... An assisted living center or continuum of care facility ... A residential care home ... An adult day care center

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: A mobile dental clinic providing dental treatment shall register with the Board of Dentistry

mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_r.quote: Volunteers shall use a form to be provided by the Board for any patient with clear instructions for any and all follow-up care.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: "Dental office" means an establishment owned and operated by a dentist for the practice of dentistry

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: prescribing, dispensing or administering opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: a dentist who utilizes the services of a dental laboratory technician or dental laboratory shall furnish a laboratory prescription for each patient for whom a work product is prescribed

teledentistry_authorized.quote: A dentist holding a valid dental license in Oklahoma may consult, diagnose and treat a patient of record via synchronous or asynchronous telecommunication between the patient and dentist.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: All patient records shall be maintained for seven (7) years from the date of treatment.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: a live, in-person cardiopulmonary resuscitation class approved by the Board

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: A dental hygienist shall not own or operate an independent practice of dental hygiene.
